newsitem.title: ESTONIA: RAKVERE SLIPS ON Q1 RESULTS, MARKET DULL.
newsitem.headline: RAKVERE SLIPS ON Q1 RESULTS, MARKET DULL.

text.p: * Total share trade was 13.5 million kroons on Tuesday
compared to 22.7 million kroons on Monday.
* Talse gained 0.01 percent to 249.04.
* Uhispank was the most active stock to be 0.20
kroons to 52.35 kroons on trade of 3.76 million kroons.
* Rakvere was 0.65 kroons lower to 13.70 kroons
after showing a loss for the first quarter.
(A complete report follows)
(See index on stock exchange web site:
http://www.tse.ee/online/total.htm)
The Estonian bourse remained dull
on Tuesday, with Rakvere and Uhispank providing some relief to
the generally slow market.
Total trade on the main list was 13.5 million kroons with
the Talse 0.01 percent up at 249.04.
"The bourse was slow with no clear movement during the day,
the selling interest in Rakvere held some of the scant
attention," one dealer said.
"We are waiting for the market to get a push, but it seems
we will have to wait until the half year results," he added.
Uhispank was most active stock on the main list with 3.7
million kroons turned over for a gain of 0.20 kroons to 52.35.
"The interest in Uhispank must be foreign, although it is
not coming from Helsinki, one trader said.
The shares are also quoted on the Helsinki bourse, where
they were at 19.80 markka versus 20 markka.
"There is no reason to out-perform the market," he added.
Rakvere dropped 0.65 kroons from 14.35 kroons in Monday's
close to 13.70 kroons on trade of two million kroons after it
reported a 7.9 million kroon loss in the first quarter of 1997.
However, it said that it remained on target for its 1997
profit estimates.
"Brokers and analysts are divided on how to call Rakvere
because the first quarter was a loss but some are saying that
its profit target is still within reach," one trader said.
The free market turned over 5.7 million kroons with Rakvere
the most active stock.
-- David Mardiste, Tallinn newsroom, +372 620 9202/1
